response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(l.HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.avg_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero average HCT makes the ratio undefined and excludes that patient from the overall mean and results.
